units.source_text: “我明说吧，师傅也许想过要让少爷同我成婚。

en.t: Let me say it plainly: perhaps my teacher once thought of having the young master marry me.

units.source_text: 可也是心想而已，嘴里从来也没有提过。

en.t: But it was only a thought in his heart; he never once said it aloud.

units.source_text: 师傅这种心思，少爷和我也都有点意识到了。

en.t: The young master and I were both somewhat aware of what my teacher had in mind.

units.source_text: 然而我们两人并没有别的什么。

en.t: But there was nothing else between the two of us.
That is all there was to it.
